warnings.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / South-West
warnings.description: Maximum wind speed : from 70 to 85 km/h. Wind sways trees and may break branches. It impedes road traffic of certain categories and may hinder movement to some extent. The sea is fairly rough (3).
warnings.instruction:

Close all windows and doors. Stow or fasten anything that could be carried away by the wind. Check the situation of vessels in berths.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of PERSISTANT RAIN
warnings.description:
There is a risk of persistent rain (level 2 of 4).
Precipitation amounts: 30-40 l/m²
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) caused by: isolated flooding of roads and subways. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
Adapt your behaviour in road traffic. Avoid flooded areas.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of FROST
warnings.description:
There is a risk of frost (level 1 of 2).
Occurence: particularly in valleys and dips; Minimum temperature: > -1 °C
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) to expect: possible frost damage. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
If necessary, take precautions against frost.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of STORM-FORCE GUSTS
warnings.description:
There is a risk of storm-force gusts (level 2 of 4).
Height range: > 1500 m; Max. gusts: < 100 km/h; Wind direction: south then south-west; Increased gusts: in exposed locations ~ 110 km/h
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) caused by: single falling trees; objects falling to the ground. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
Secure scaffolding and free-standing objects (e.g. screens and platforms/stages). For example, fasten tents and coverings or, if there is enough time, take them down completely. Watch out for falling objects (e.g. large branches, roof tiles) and seek shelter if possible.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of GALE-FORCE GUSTS
warnings.description:

Max. gusts: 55-70 km/h; Wind direction: south then south-west; Increased gusts: in exposed locations ~ 75 km/h
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) caused by: single branches falling; objects flying through the air. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
Secure free-standing objects (e.g. screens and furniture). For example, fasten tents and coverings. Watch out for falling objects outdoors (e.g. branches).
